name: Sweet Lake Biscuits (Draper, UT) Fresh Mint Limeade (Concentrated Citrus Warning)
whyItWorks: Sweet Lake is famous for fresh-squeezed limeade! However, concentrated lime juice citric acid causes direct chemical irritation, burning, and spasms in ulcerated bowel tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during flareups and citrus intolerance. In remission, dilute heavily with ice water or choose herbal iced tea.
watchOuts: Raw lime juice citric acid burns inflamed intestinal mucosa
